steps: Install the Ibotta app and create a free account.
Before shopping, browse the app and tap (+) to add offers for products you plan to buy to 'Your list'.
Shop as normal and keep your receipt.
Submit the receipt in the app (or link loyalty accounts at supported retailers for automatic credit).
Cash back lands after the pending period; withdraw at $20 via PayPal, Venmo, or gift cards.
